description: Find XRPL payment paths from source_account to destination_amount for destination_account. Returns XRPL path alternatives and source-amount information for payment execution planning. Use this for payment path discovery; use n9t2_xrpl_get_book_offers instead for DEX order-book depth.

destination_account.description: XRPL classic account address that will receive the destination amount.
destination_account.title: Destination Account

destination_amount.description: Destination amount to deliver. Use a string for XRP drops or an issued-currency object containing currency, issuer, and value.
destination_amount.title: Destination Amount

source_account.description: XRPL classic account address used as the source of payment-path discovery.
source_account.title: Source Account

name: n9t2_xrpl_find_path
